neighbours.label: a token in the rules of a tabletop or war game (When a squad shoots, it fires; if you fail your test, you lose)
fire: When a unit charges, it rolls one die per model in the unit.
If you don't roll enough hits, you can reroll one attack.
Any time you fail your Willpower Check, you lose one point.
To capture a bunker, move the tank within two hexes.
When a knight attacks, it deals one wound per weapon it holds.
If you score a critical hit, you may draw another card.
Any time your hero takes damage, you discard one token.
Each player rolls a die, and the highest roll goes first.
quiet: When a choir rehearses, it sings one hymn per week in the hall.
If you don't get enough sleep, you can rest on Sunday.
Any time you miss your bus, you lose an hour.
To reach the bakery, walk down the street past two shops.
When a nurse arrives, she checks one chart per patient on the ward.
If you buy a new house, you may need another loan.
Any time your son comes home, you cook a meal.
Each student buys a book, and the oldest reads first.

notes: Card: ' with' x3, ' you' x2, ',', '\n', ' the', ' it', ' Skill', all in tabletop and game rule text. Probes: 'fires one shot per unit in the squad' 0.852, 'score enough successes' 0.537, 'fail your Composure Test' 0.524, 'move the APC' 0.292; a singer 0.071, visiting an aunt 0.025. Near misses keep the sentence frames outside games.
